title: Boundary vanishing for proper image of open extension
statement: Fix ell, k and an admissible condensed coefficient Lambda as above. For a proper morphism r:W\to Y and a quasi-compact open immersion i:V\to Y of separated finite-type k-schemes, write b:W\times _Y V\to W and c:Y\V\to Y for the open pullback and reduced closed complement. For every K in Loc(Dctf(W\times _Y V,Lambda)), the derived closed restriction c* of Rr* b! K is zero. Notions and canonical constructions: [sk-def-localizing-closure], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek].

source.place: Proof (3), closed proper base change and localizing extension

proof.text: On bounded constructible finite-Tor generators, use proper_open_boundary_zero for the finite-subextension coefficient cases. For continuous algebraic-closure coefficients use qcqs closed proper base change and the disjointness of the two pullbacks to show the restricted open extension is zero.

The proper compact-support functor for the compactification (b,r) preserves sums on the localizing closure. Exact closed restriction is a left adjoint and preserves sums. Their composite is triangulated, and its kernel intersected with the localizing closure is replete, triangulated and sum-closed. It contains every generator, so minimality extends vanishing to all inputs.
